title: Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA Mega Mix
notes: Songs played: LOL Luka Luka Night Fever Magnet Solitude's End
issues: Songs that use more complicated music videos tend to fluctuate between 30 and 60 fps. Songs with simpler music videos or ones that use a video file for the background instead of the in-game engine stay at a constant 60. I installed the game onto an external hard drive which resulted in some songs taking up to 40 seconds to load.
